cases.name: Teghan Alyssa Skiba
cases.narrative: Richardson abused and tortured Teghan in the 15-by-13-foot shed behind the Smithfield home of his grandparents while her mother – his girlfriend at the time – Helen Reyes, was out of the state for Army Reserve training. He took her to a local hospital on July 16, 2010. She had 144 wounds, including 66 bite marks, on her face and 40-pound body. She died three days later from blunt force trauma to the head.
